hero.line: I design logos, brand identities and campaign posters that help businesses get noticed and remembered, and I illustrate the rest, from pencil sketch to finished artwork.

work.title: Client work first, sketchbook last.
work.intro: Logos, identities and campaigns for clients in Benin and Ghana, followed by illustration and pages from the sketchbook.

services.title: What I can do for you

items.d: Logos, colour and type choices, variations and a simple brand charter your team can actually use.
Print and social posters for launches, events and weekly programmes, in every format the campaign needs.
Portraits, mascots, scenes and patterns, from pencil sketch to finished digital artwork.
Promo edits, event films and motion graphics for social media and screens.

about.title: Ten years of agency and client work.
about.photo: Portrait of Yannick Bamona — photo to come
about.bio1: I’m Yannick Bamona, a graphic designer and illustrator based in Cotonou. I studied graphic design at Studio M in Casablanca, and since 2016 I’ve designed logos, brand charters and campaign posters for agencies in Benin and their clients, from an insurer to a menswear brand to Canal+.
about.bio2: I start from the client’s problem: who needs to notice the brand, where they will see it, and what they should remember. Drawing is how I think, so most projects begin in pencil before they become vectors.

timeline.d: Logos, variations and brand charters; campaign posters for Men In Suits (Ghana) and LB Assur.
Logos for Idylle Déco and Pastry’s House; video editing for a gala event in Morocco, for Aidreve, and three films with director Le Kipré.
Posters for a seaside resort, logos for several clients, audiovisual planning for a large public event.
Weekly posters for Canal+, the agency mascot, and logos for clients.
